name: readme-2-ci-poll-loop
command:
cd /home/nixos/Documents/personal/repositories/Project-Atlas && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  sleep 20
  out=$(gh run view 29855311448 --json status,conclusion 2>&1)
  status=$(echo "$out" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['status'])")
  echo "$(date +%T) $out"
  if [ "$status" = "completed" ]; then break; fi
done
